create_Point_message: create a Point protobuf message with latitude and longitude fields for route guide coordinates
create_Rectangle_message: create a Rectangle protobuf message with lo and hi Point fields defining a geographic bounding box
create_Feature_message: create a Feature protobuf message with a name string and location Point for named geographic features
create_RouteNote_message: create a RouteNote protobuf message with a location Point and message string for route chat notes
create_RouteSummary_message: create a RouteSummary protobuf message with point_count, feature_count, distance, and elapsed_time fields
